description: This tilted grouped bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different sentiment analysis tools across two categories of tweets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, specifically "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet," and features an overarching axis label reading "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis." The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy," utilizing a linear scale with a visible numeric range from 0.0 to 0.8 and tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.2, accompanied by dashed horizontal grid lines. The data is organized into two groups of three bars, with the components defined by an overlaid legend: plain white bars with black outlines represent "TEXTBLOB," white bars with black diagonal hatching represent "VADER," and solid green bars represent "ChatGPT." For the "Emoji Tweets" category, the TEXTBLOB bar is the shortest at approximately 0.35, the VADER bar is roughly 0.55, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 0.85. In the "Overall Tweet" category, the TEXTBLOB bar reaches about 0.65, the VADER bar is approximately 0.80, and the ChatGPT bar is the tallest in the chart, extending to roughly 0.95. Within each group, the bars are ordered from left to right as TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, which visually corresponds to an ascending order of height in both categories.
